purpose: provenance-tagged working ranges for palette design; every value carries how it was obtained
standing_rule: NOTHING here is a BBROSE specification. No value is OWNER_CONFIRMED or MANUFACTURER_CONFIRMED yet — those columns are deliberately empty until the owner rules or a supplier drawing arrives.

diameter_mm.note: 26 is a genuine cross-vendor refill interchange standard; 30 and 36 coexist; 58.5 is the recurring pressed-powder godet

depth_mm.note: two depth families at the same diameter; depth is independent of diameter

wall_tolerance.provenance: ONLINE_REPORTED (R10 patent explicitly states pressed-powder pans have wide size tolerance)
wall_tolerance.design_consequence: pan pockets need a clearance parameter and compliant retention; never an interference fit

recommended_clearance_mm.provenance: CALCULATED (from the wide-tolerance statement + typical moulding tolerance; NOT measured)

aspect_ratio.note: outer proportion is a FREE design variable — no industry norm constrains it

pan_pitch_mm.example_83mm_case: 9 x 26 mm pans in 83 mm => pitch ~27.0-27.3, gap ~1.0-1.3, outer margin ~1.5-2.0

inter_pan_gap_mm.provenance: CALCULATED (bounded by the tight R6 case and the generous R4 case)

recommended_minimum_gap_mm.provenance: DESIGN_DEFAULT — below this, moulded pocket walls approach the ABS minimum wall and powder cross-contamination risk rises

open_angle_deg.value: obtuse — a functional requirement so the lid mirror faces the user
open_angle_deg.provenance: ONLINE_REPORTED as qualitative (R12); the numeric range is DESIGN_DEFAULT and unvalidated

hinge_family.value: gudgeons + pivot pin + resilient snap jaws (classic); alternatives: living hinge, external barrel

clasp_family.value: mechanical detent clasp OR magnetic closure

mirror.thickness_mm: UNKNOWN — not published in any source found

magnet.value: magnet-lined pockets or ferromagnetic base plate

mixed_pan_module_equivalence.alternative_reported: 4 small pans OR 1 large pan OR 1 medium + 2 small in the same zone
mixed_pan_module_equivalence.design_consequence: module occupancy is ONE of two supported placement modes (MODULE_LATTICE); the other (ABSOLUTE_DIMENSIONAL_LAYOUT) places pans by explicit coordinates and dimensions
mixed_pan_module_equivalence.owner_correction_2026_08_05: NOT a manufacturer/industry standard and NOT a production rule. A layout heuristic only. Every module must resolve to explicit dimensions; the engine must also support direct dimension-based placement.

explicit_unknowns: hinge pin diameter and gudgeon dimensions
magnet grade, thickness and pull force
any BBROSE-specific preference on format, size or refillability

owner_decisions_2026_08_05.PRIMARY_CASE_MATERIAL: ABS (PP allowed for intentional living-hinge structures)
owner_decisions_2026_08_05.SUPPLIER_TECHNICAL_DRAWING_RESEARCH: AUTHORIZED — research and prepare requests only; no orders, quantities, commercial terms or patent-clearance claims
